concerns.text: T019 implements a fallback download from Figshare if HuggingFace fails. This violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which mandates: 'External datasets MUST be fetched from the same canonical source on every run.' A fallback mechanism introduces non-deterministic source selection, breaking reproducibility unless the fallback is explicitly authorized as a non-reproducible exception in the spec (which it is not).

T022a implements a strategy to 'exclude the specific scaffold group from the dataset entirely' if cross-class scaffolds are found. This silently weakens FR-004 ('System MUST split the dataset... to prevent data leakage') by introducing arbitrary data deletion rather than a partitioning strategy. The spec does not authorize data loss as a splitting mechanism; this is a semantic relaxation of the requirement to 'split' into 'delete and split'.

T035a defines 'high-yield' using a threshold derived from the **training set** and applies it to the **held-out test set** to verify SC-003. SC-003 requires validation against a 'held-out validation set' (implying a distinct set or the test set with a valid baseline). Using a training-derived threshold on a test set creates a circular dependency and invalidates the success criterion measurement, as the threshold is not derived from the distribution being tested. This weakens the verification of SC-003.

T022c generates train/validation splits but does not explicitly output the 'remaining groups' required for T022d to generate the test set. T022d's prerequisite is T022c, but T022c's description does not guarantee the existence of the 'remaining groups' data structure needed for T022d. This breaks the logical chain required to satisfy FR-004 (splitting into train/val/test) and SC-001 (test set evaluation), effectively dropping the test set generation logic.

T031a computes per-class metrics but does not implement the logic to filter classes by sample count (n > 20) or calculate the generalization gap (Training R² - Test R²) as required by SC-002. The task produces raw metrics but fails to implement the specific verification logic for the success criterion, silently weakening the requirement to 'ensure model robustness' via the defined gap metric.
